content: नैमित्तिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Produced by, connected with, or dependent on, any particular cause. .²2 Unusual, occasional, accidental, produced by some cause (<ab>opp.</ab> नित्य). .{@-कः@} An astrologer, prophet. .{@-कम्@} .²1 An effect (<ab>opp.</ab> निमित्त ‘cause’); निमित्तनैमित्तिकयोरयं क्रमः <ls>Ś. 7. 30</ls>. .²2 An occasional rite, a periodical ceremony, a conditional act, an act which is to be performed on the occurrence of a निमित्त; निमित्तप्राप्तौ च नैमित्तिकं कर्तव्यम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 18</ls>.
